value: Act as an expert software developer
You are an expert AI software engineering agent

notes: 0.4.3 (the last PyPI release) through litellm: the same OpenAI/Python + x-stainless-raw-response headers as Aider and OpenHands, told apart by the identity ('You are Open Interpreter, a world-class programmer that can complete any goal by executing code') and the single 'execute' tool (language enum + code). Identical on the first turn, after the tool call and on the follow-up; the CLI entry point sends max_tokens 4096, the Python SDK entry point 16384. The current Codex-based Open Interpreter CLI (github releases only) is a different program: its native wire shape is Codex's (originator codex_exec, codex_exec/0.159.0 user-agent, 'You are Codex' prompt) and its claude-code harness imitates Claude Code's headers, so it identifies as those products; not captured here.
